title: The Forgotten Crown
author: Xanthe Kavanagh
blurb: Vesper Dunmore, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
